answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 10799 Country: India Title: as salam walequm. my question is- I reach a masjid after zohar ajaan and find that there is some 3 to 4 minutes left before the Zohar jamat will begin. Now there are two things i need to do, i.e. i need to pray the dakhila masjid namaz and also i need to pray the 4 rakat sunnah tul muekada of zohar. but as there is only 3-4 minutes left for the jamat of faraz namaj to start what should i do. options with me are 1. i pray the 4 rakats of sunnatul mu-ekada and leave the dakhila masjid namaj. 2. i read the dakhila masjid namaj and read the 4 rakats of sunnatul mu-ekada after the faraz namaj. which of the two options are better or is there any other better option for me. jajak-Allah hu khair. Now there are two things i need to do, i.e. i need to pray the dakhila masjid namaz and also i need to pray the 4 rakat sunnah tul muekada of zohar. but as there is only 3-4 minutes left for the jamat of faraz namaj to start what should i do. options with me are 1. i pray the 4 rakats of sunnatul mu-ekada and leave the dakhila masjid namaj. 2. i read the dakhila masjid namaj and read the 4 rakats of sunnatul mu-ekada after the faraz namaj. which of the two options are better or is there any other better option for me. jajak-Allah hu khair. Answer ID: 10799 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 288/262=B/1430) In this case when you reach mosque, you should recite thrice: سبحان اللہ والحمد للہ، لا إلہ إلا اللہ واللہ أکبر You will get the reward of tahiyatul masjid, and having offered sunnah muakkadah join the congregation ( Jamaat ). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
